headline: Sul Ross State yet to score after eight defeats
dek: Sul Ross State have lost all eight of their matches, conceding 35 goals and scoring none, and the latest defeat came at St. Edward's. Midwestern State, at the other end of the table, have yet to lose.
displaced_by: Standing lines counted six straight wins and ten matches; Midwestern State have now played eleven and won seven in a row. Sul Ross State's eighth goalless defeat takes the lede.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's 31 goals, and Parker Plaxco has eight of them.

wire.line: Jake Morris has kept five shutouts for Midwestern State and conceded seven goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, UT Dallas's at Ouachita Baptist, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Midwestern State have scored 31 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and conceded seven in an unbeaten season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: St. Mary's have not drawn a match this season: six wins and three defeats in nine.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have lost once in ten matches and conceded eight goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made 54 saves for Sul Ross State.

last_match.line: Midwestern State remain the conference's only unbeaten side; UT Tyler are still without a conference win.

next_match.line: Oklahoma Christian have not lost a conference match; Midwestern State have not lost any match.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
